prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Ava from <Picture 1>, a complete character sheet whose face close-up, front, side and back panels depict the same young woman in one state. She has long straight black hair with loose strands framing her face, dark brown eyes, a small beauty mark beside one eye, balanced facial proportions, and faint low-saturation gray-brown linear marks on one arm. She wears a light beige sleeveless crew-neck tank top, matching slim trousers with a matching belt, and pale gray lace-up sneakers with white soles.
<Subject 4> is the giant shark from <Picture 4>, a multi-view sheet showing the same huge great-white-like creature from front, side, rear and three-quarter views. It has rough dark blue-gray upper skin, a white lower jaw and underbelly, pronounced gill folds, a tall triangular dorsal fin, broad pectoral fins, black eyes, and multiple rows of large triangular teeth in wide jaws.
<Subject 2> is the post-apocalyptic ocean from <Picture 2>, a storm-lashed seascape containing a rusted dark ocean liner listing on the left, two red-and-black funnels, exposed masts and rigging, shattered small boats, floating wooden wreckage, towering gray-blue waves, white surf and heavy storm clouds. The shark visible in that environment is the same creature defined by <Subject 4>, not a separate animal.
<Subject 3> is the ocean-infrastructure system phone from <Picture 3>, a multi-view sheet of one silver-gray smartphone with rounded metallic edges, side buttons, a black triple-lens rear-camera block and a glossy front screen. Its deep-blue interface contains translucent rounded cards, white line icons, check marks, small status symbols, numeric readouts, glowing particles and a circular holographic-style light platform; the card text is not reliably legible, so only its interface design and the story-specified "重生" option are used.

summary:
[reference generation] Continuing Ava’s fall into the storm-wrecked seascape of <Subject 2>, <Subject 4> bites and holds <Subject 1>’s lower leg underwater as she struggles. When her vision blurs, a holographic countdown derived from the blue interface language of <Subject 3> appears; Ava selects "重生", and the expanding system light engulfs the shark’s jaws.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - Ava’s facial identity, long black hair, body proportions, beige tank top, belted trousers and sneakers remain consistent, with only wet hair, soaked fabric and pained expression changing.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - The shark retains its blue-gray upper body, white underbelly, black eye, fins, gill folds and triangular-toothed jaws, with the bite shown through contact and occlusion.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - The wrecked liner, floating debris, cold gray-blue water, storm atmosphere and wave-torn surface are preserved from a new underwater upward viewpoint.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): attribute_transfer - The phone’s glowing blue translucent cards, icons, check marks, particles and circular interface design transfer to the underwater hologram, while the physical phone casing is not shown.

detailed_description:
Cinematic semi-realistic 3D rendering preserves the reference facial proportions and clothing designs, with soft skin shading, fine wet hair strands, clinging fabric texture and coherent underwater contact shadows. Ava, the shark, wreckage and water share the same cold storm-filtered light and three-dimensional material quality.

[Shot 1] Continuing directly from the prior frozen pose, the camera is underwater in a medium half-low-angle shot looking up through turbulent blue-gray water toward the churning surface. The listing rusted liner, masts and floating debris from <Subject 2> loom dimly above and in the background. <Subject 4> surges upward from below, its black eye, white lower jaw, gill folds and rows of triangular teeth centered as its jaws close firmly on Ava’s lower leg. The bite is shown through tooth-and-jaw contact, pressed wet trouser fabric and occlusion, without an open-wound close-up; a small cloud of low-saturation dark green disperses beside the contact. <Subject 1> hangs upward in the water with her long black hair fanning out, her beige tank top and trousers soaked, torso rigid with shock. <Subject 1> (S1) opens her mouth in a wordless scream, and her hands slap uselessly toward the rippling surface. The camera gives one brief rough shake on impact, then stops abruptly while the shark’s jaws remain closed. Synchronized sound includes a heavy crushing bite, Ava’s scream, churning water and bubbles, and a single muffled heartbeat.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close facial shot and slowly pushes toward Ava. The shark’s clamped grip remains below the frame, bubbles rise past her face, and the dark green water cloud drifts at her side. Her eyes first blur, then focus again as a holographic window blooms between her and the shadowed jaws. The hologram transfers the visual design of <Subject 3>: deep-blue translucent rounded panels, glowing line icons, check marks, drifting particles and a circular light platform, without showing the phone body. Its central display shows "3", then "2", then "1" in sequence. The off-screen electronic female system voice (S2), in en-US with no visible speaker and no lip-sync source, says, <d>[English] Rebirth countdown: three, two, one.</d> Each numeral changes with a precise holographic tick, while the muffled heartbeat continues and the underwater hum gradually lowers. Ava stares through the pain and locks her gaze on the window; her lips remain closed while the system voice speaks.

[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the camera holds in a near close shot of Ava’s face and trembling hand, with the countdown window still glowing before her. A selectable option at the lower edge is labeled "重生". With the shark’s bite still holding her below frame, <Subject 1> (S1) raises a shaking hand and presses the glowing option. Her face remains visible as she speaks in en-US, and her lip movements are visibly synchronized with the English line, <d>[English] I choose rebirth.</d> A clear system confirmation chime responds at the touch. The interface immediately expands from its center in a rapid wave of blue panels and particles, and the camera makes one short sharp shake. The light washes over Ava’s face and spreads outward until it engulfs <Subject 4>’s clamped jaws, accompanied by a huge resonant electronic hum that overwhelms the heartbeat and underwater ambience.

overall_soundscape:
Pressurized underwater rumble, distant storm waves, drifting bubbles and the low groan of wreckage run beneath the scene. The shark’s heavy bite, Ava’s scream and pained breathing, muffled heartbeat, holographic ticks, confirmation chime and expanding interface hum are synchronized with the visible actions. The final electronic resonance swallows most of the underwater ambience.
